responsibility: This file implements GCC’s GIMPLE tracer pass for superblock formation by tail duplication. It analyzes profile counts and edge probabilities, chooses hot traces by repeatedly selecting best predecessors and successors, uses duplication eligibility checks to decide when to copy join blocks, duplicates blocks to linearize hot paths, and returns CFG cleanup and SSA-update work when changes occur. Its responsibility is profile-guided trace construction and tail duplication to improve block layout and optimization opportunities on hot paths.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/tracer.h, which exposes only a tiny reusable interface, this .cc file contains the actual tracer pass implementation: hot-trace selection, probability/count heuristics, tail duplication, CFG updates, and pass registration for the GIMPLE superblock-forming optimization.
